stem: Which of these is the best definition of an era?

options.label: F
options.text: A period of time identified by political, economic, or social trends

options.label: G
options.text: A series of various changes over many years

options.label: H
options.text: A series of events unified by individual or organized protests

options.label: J
options.text: A period of time lasting between 10 and 15 years
